name: Lord's Mark Industries Limited
about: Lord's Mark Industries Limited engages in providing rendering consultancy services for power projects in India. It is involved in the generation and distribution of power from conventional and renewable sources. The company also manufactures and trades in electrical equipment, pharmaceuticals, paper products, LED lighting solutions, solar products, and electric vehicles. In addition, it acts as a consultant and agent for the energy and allied sectors; and trades in machinery. The company was formerly known as Lords Mark India Limited and changed its name to Lord's Mark Industries Limited in October 2025. Lord's Mark Industries Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Mumbai, India.
